title: GOD SETTETH THE
SOLITARY IN FAMILIES
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm lamp lit open bible on wooden table
soft focus olive branches in ceramic vase
empty cozy living room with soft evening glow
peaceful countryside home view at twilight
gently flickering candle on a prayer table
warm sunlight streaming into a quiet home

scenes.a: If the loneliness of this season feels like a wall around your heart, please listen.
God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
Father, we bring our empty chairs and our quiet halls to You tonight.
You are the one who binds the broken pieces of our weary hearts together.
Break the chains of isolation and lead us into the safety of Your love.
Fill our rooms with the warmth of Your purpose and the peace of belonging.
